Exact neural encoding gives exact surrogate forward evaluation, not a certified approximation or optimum for the original two-stage stochastic program.
Reported 0.11–1.66s NN-E times exclude offline learning and true-recourse reevaluation; EF-incumbent differences are not universal optimality gaps and small INVP/pooling cases show negative results.
Models train for fixed base instances/configurations and transfer across scenario sets/counts, with no demonstrated unchanged model across four native problem families.
